subject: Freight rates for the 2027 peak season
body: Thank you for your letter of 2 October asking about freight for next year's peak season.

From 1 February 2027 our rate for palletised freight from Griffith to Brisbane will be $2.85 per pallet kilometre, up from $2.70, because of higher fuel and road-user charges. Bookings made before 15 December will be charged at this year's rate.
I would be happy to meet your board to go through the rates.
